notes: Reviewed: 'or else' counted as two words for two morphemes (waw 'else', אִם 'or'), while the earlier וְאִם written as bare 'or' leaves its waw unrepresented; 'even' to the waw before pestilence with margin 'and' set aside; אֶת before שֹׁלְחִי takes 'to' as the preposition the verb needs to reach its object.
